title: Sum of All Odd Length Subarrays
statement: You are given an array `arr` of positive integers. Look at every subarray of `arr` (a contiguous, non-empty block of elements) whose length is odd, take the sum of each one, and return the total of all those sums.
notes:
## Intuition

The direct way lists every odd-length subarray and adds up its elements, which is O(n³) (or O(n²) with prefix sums). Turn the question around: each element `arr[i]` contributes `arr[i]` times the number of odd-length subarrays that contain it. That count depends only on `i` and `n`, so the whole answer is one weighted sum.

## Approach

1. A subarray containing index `i` starts some distance `d1` before `i` (0 to `i`) and ends some distance `d2` after it (0 to `n - 1 - i`). Its length is `d1 + d2 + 1`, which is odd exactly when `d1` and `d2` are both even or both odd.
2. Count even and odd choices on each side: `leftEven = floor(i / 2) + 1`, `leftOdd = floor((i + 1) / 2)`, and the same with `n - 1 - i` on the right.
3. `oddCount = leftEven * rightEven + leftOdd * rightOdd` is the number of odd-length subarrays containing `i`.
4. Add `arr[i] * oddCount` to `total` for every `i`, and return `total`.

## Example 1, step by step

`arr = [1, 4, 2, 5, 3]`, `n = 5`. For `i = 0`: `leftEven = 1`, `leftOdd = 0`, `rightEven = 3`, `rightOdd = 2`, so `oddCount = 3`. The counts for `i = 0..4` are `3, 4, 5, 4, 3`, and `total = 1·3 + 4·4 + 2·5 + 5·4 + 3·3 = 3 + 16 + 10 + 20 + 9 = 58`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n): constant work per index.
- Space: O(1).

## Pitfalls

- A distance of 0 counts as even, hence the `+ 1` in `leftEven` and `rightEven`.
- Odd-length subarrays containing `i` are not simply half of the `(i + 1) * (n - i)` subarrays containing it; when that product is odd there is one more odd-length subarray, which the parity count handles automatically (it equals the product divided by 2, rounded up).
- Subarrays are contiguous; do not count subsequences.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `n` | length of `arr` |
| `i` | index of the element whose contribution is counted |
| `leftEven`, `leftOdd` | starts at an even / odd distance before `i` |
| `rightEven`, `rightOdd` | ends at an even / odd distance after `i` |
| `oddCount` | odd-length subarrays that contain `i` |
| `total` | running sum of all contributions |
